description: This file defines the AdHocDataValidator class, which performs validation checks on JSON input for creating or updating ad hoc report data objects, including parameter validation and constraint enforcement.

classes.name: AdHocDataValidator
classes.description: A component responsible for validating JSON data used to create or update ad hoc query reports, ensuring required fields are present and constraints are met.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates the input JSON for creating a new ad hoc data report, checking for required parameters and ranges, and raising validation errors if necessary.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the input JSON for updating an existing ad hoc data report, with checks for optional parameters and constraints.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if there are validation errors collected during the validation process.
